abstract: RhoDyn is a standalone Python toolkit for residence-window scoring, bounded-coupling decisions, reserve-like buffering summaries, stochastic timing utilities, reduced-architecture comparison, reproducible reports, a command-line interface, a backend service, and a contract-bound browser workbench for live-cell signaling and perturbation data. The software is independent from the RhoA/microglia manuscript; manuscript materials are optional reference use cases, not runtime dependencies.
title: RhoDyn: dynamic residence-state analysis for live-cell signaling and perturbation data
